name: vipsocial-hub
description: VIPSocial Editorial Hub — Monorepo (API + Web + Packages)

scripts.validate: pnpm validate:web && pnpm validate:gallery && pnpm validate:api && pnpm validate:contract
scripts.validate:web: pnpm --dir apps/web lint && pnpm --dir apps/web test && pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck && pnpm --dir apps/web build
scripts.validate:gallery: pnpm --dir gallery lint && pnpm --dir gallery test && pnpm --dir gallery typecheck && pnpm --dir gallery build
scripts.validate:api: pnpm --dir apps/api test && pnpm --dir apps/api lint
scripts.validate:contract: pnpm api:generate-spec && pnpm api:generate-client && pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck
